title: Blocking Templates. Four Templates in Full Color

description.main: Christopher Williams's spiral-bound book for Heimarbeit. Adapted for Use. IKEA Küchen Ensemble., his 2023 exhibition at Galerie Gisela Capitain in Cologne. It documents the show and reprints a 1972 panel discussion on Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Oberösterreich.
description.extended:
Blocking Templates is the spiral-bound book Christopher Williams made for Heimarbeit. Adapted for Use. IKEA Küchen Ensemble., his 2023 exhibition at Galerie Gisela Capitain in Cologne.

The exhibition brought together six hand-painted signs, four new color photographs, five new wall treatments, two new films, a sculpture, this publication, and one unique arrangement. Petra Hollenbach designed the 78-page book. It documents the project and reprints a panel discussion from Theater in der Kritik on Franz Xaver Kroetz's play Oberösterreich, a recording held in the ZDF archive since 1972. Four full-color plates and four technical drawings describe the adaptable IKEA Metod kitchen set.

Williams was born in Los Angeles in 1956 and has been a professor at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf since 2008. The kitchen set joins other household goods in his Adapted for Use projects. Earlier ones include Footwear (Adapted for Use) at David Zwirner, New York, in 2020 and Kochgeschirr (Adapted for use) at Capitain Petzel, Berlin. The book's title was later used for an exhibition at the haubrok foundation's FAHRBEREITSCHAFT in Berlin.
